evidence.text: Texas Pacific Land (TPL) rose 5.42% in premarket trading on November 5, 2026.
Total revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $273.4 million compared to $246.1 million for the second quarter of 2026.
The Company reported net income of $167.4 million for the third quarter of 2026 compared to net income of $153.9 million for the second quarter of 2026.

en.hook: Revenue and net income both stepped up
en.watch: Stock Titan reports revenues of $273.4 million against $246.1 million in the prior quarter, and net income of $167.4 million against $153.9 million, so whether revenue keeps rising sequentially is the point to track.

zh.hook: 营收与净利润均环比增长
zh.watch: 据Stock Titan报道，营收为2.734亿美元，上一季度为2.461亿美元，净利润为1.674亿美元，上一季度为1.539亿美元，营收能否继续环比增长是关注点。

evidence.text: Nvidia (NVDA) fell 4.27% in the regular session on November 9, 2026.
Nvidia’s board said on Sunday it has opened an independent investigation, and the company said Jensen Huang continues as CEO.
Nvidia’s board has launched an independent investigation, although it said there is currently no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.
Expected report date, not confirmed by the company: November 17, 2026.

en.watch: TipRanks reports the board opened an independent investigation while saying there is currently no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised, so any update from it matters ahead of an expected report on November 17, a date the company has not confirmed.

zh.watch: 据TipRanks报道，董事会已启动独立调查，并称目前没有理由认为国家安全或公司机密受到影响，因此调查的任何进展都值得关注，财报日期暂定为11月17日（未经公司确认）。
